# Fuling trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyGoblin | Source: Fuling | Usage: Decoration; fishing bait | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Fuling trophy is a rare drop from Fulings.

## Crafting:

• Stingy fishing bait

## Notes

• Like all other trophies, it can be mounted on an item stand.
• Can be used to program Balistas.
